podium.info_copy:
The leaderboards are set to a %{days} day rolling system. That means they show your %{metric} history for just the last %{days} days.

To get higher up the leaderboard, aim to do more than you did %{days} days ago!

communities_info.heading: Communities
communities_info.content: These can represent the entire company or specific groups that your HR has set up. You can filter your leaderboards based on the groups you are assigned to.

steps_info.heading: Steps Leaderboard
steps_info.content: This 30-day rolling leaderboard is where your daily steps fuel your rise to fame. Every day your steps are added to your grand total whilst your old steps are rotated off the leaderboard.

cycling_info.heading: Cycling Leaderboard
cycling_info.content: Our rolling monthly leaderboard where your cycled distance count towards your ranking. Each day your distance is added to your total. As a new day begins, the steps from the oldest day are automatically removed, ensuring that your position reflects your most recent activity in a frame of 30 days.

yudoku_info.heading: Yudoku Leaderboard
yudoku_info.content: This daily leaderboard reveals the latest, mind-boggling Yudoku times. Get those thinking caps on and let's see who can Yudoku their way to the top spot today!

title.jp: How to play the Number Puzzle

outline.default: To play Yudoku – fill in a 9x9 grid with numbers 1 to 9, such that each number appears only once in each row, each column, and each 3x3 block. The objective is to have a completed and correct grid by the end of the game.
outline.jp: To play the Number Puzzle – fill in a 9x9 grid with numbers 1 to 9, such that each number appears only once in each row, each column, and each 3x3 block. The objective is to have a completed and correct grid by the end of the game.

1.jp: The basic rules of the Number Puzzle:

2.default: The Yudoku grid is made up of 9x9 cells.
2.jp: The Number Puzzle grid is made up of 9x9 cells.

help.3: You are only allowed to use numbers 1 to 9.
help.4: In each 3x3 block, only numbers 1 to 9 can be used.
help.5: Each vertical column must also only contain numbers 1 to 9.
help.6: Similarly, each horizontal row must also only contain numbers 1 to 9.
help.7: No number in the 3x3 block, vertical column, or horizontal row can be repeated.
